title: The Drop of the Green Zone
author: Casper Ishikawa
blurb: Wendell Ishikawa, a burnt analyst bounced from three agencies, hasn't slept through the night since the incident. Then a stranger returns a favor that never happened, with interest owed — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must stop an attack scheduled to look like an accident before the summit convenes.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
